metadata.grain: one original unlinked GetStop ID, accounted against complete published TDX station order

source_terms.note: 保留各來源條款；不將eBus網頁宣稱為開放資料授權。

limitations: 各來源快照時間獨立保留；多欄等價只核對所列快照，不推論跨版本永久ID規則。
今日未營運不等於永久停用；未列PathDetail不補造附線會員。

coverage.scope: all published NewTaipei StopOfRoute pages at retained snapshots

identifier_evidence.tdx_rule: StopID/RouteID/SubRouteID are source internal codes; UID is authority prefix plus internal ID
identifier_evidence.direction_rule: GetStop.goBack joined by explicit PathDetail.stopId; PathDetail.type is never used as direction

comparison_rules: Join only explicit ID and main/subroute/operator relations; names and positions corroborate.
Compare complete ordered StopID arrays; preserve original ordinals without assuming a fixed offset.
Direct-only points are classified only by their explicit 虛擬站不停靠 source annotation; omitted IDs are retained.
Coordinate conflicts do not alter either source coordinate. No cause or permanent withdrawal is inferred.
